create_video_tracking_multiplex_demo: create a VideoTrackingMultiplexDemo instance for multi-object video tracking with point and mask interaction support
run_video_tracking_propagation: run propagate_in_video to track objects across all frames starting from annotated keyframes
add_new_points_tracking: add_new_points to annotate objects with click coordinates and labels on a specific video frame
add_new_masks_tracking: add_new_masks to annotate objects with segmentation masks on a specific video frame
remove_tracking_object: remove a tracked object from the multiplex tracking state and update remaining object indices
